crossRefs.note: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”
lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.
Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.
They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, of bronze, of iron, of wood, and of stone.
On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.
These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves…
wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been…

translations.web: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
translations.bsb: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will utter perversities.
translations.kjv: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
translations.asv: Thine eyes shall behold strange things, And thy heart shall utter perverse things.
